tables.name: public.providers
tables.comment: A business or host that sells Services or Experiences. One per login (owner_id is unique). Never deleted: bookings and payouts will point here, so a provider is suspended instead.

columns.name: owner_id
columns.comment: The login that owns and manages this provider. A user is a provider exactly when they own a row here. The login cannot be deleted while it owns a provider: suspend or anonymize the provider first.

columns.name: display_name
columns.comment: The business name. Public: shown on the provider's visible listings ("Hosted by ...").

columns.name: status
columns.comment: active or suspended. Only admins change it (service role); a suspended provider cannot use provider routes.

columns.name: stripe_account_id
columns.comment: The provider's Stripe Connect Express account. Created by the server on first payout setup.

columns.name: stripe_details_submitted
columns.comment: Copied from Stripe: the provider finished the onboarding form. Server-only.

columns.name: stripe_charges_enabled
columns.comment: Copied from Stripe: payments can be made to this provider. Server-only.

columns.name: stripe_payouts_enabled
columns.comment: Copied from Stripe: Stripe can pay out to the provider's bank. Server-only.

columns.name: city_id
columns.comment: The city the provider operates in, picked from active cities. Replaces the old free-text city.

indexes.name: providers_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX providers_pkey ON public.providers USING btree (id)

indexes.name: providers_owner_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX providers_owner_id_key ON public.providers USING btree (owner_id)

indexes.name: providers_stripe_account_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX providers_stripe_account_id_key ON public.providers USING btree (stripe_account_id)

indexes.name: providers_city_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX providers_city_id_idx ON public.providers USING btree (city_id)

constraints.name: providers_owner_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (owner_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: providers_city_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (city_id) REFERENCES cities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: providers_city_active
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER providers_city_active BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF city_id ON public.providers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION providers_check_city_active()

triggers.name: providers_owner_not_admin
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER providers_owner_not_admin BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF owner_id ON public.providers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION providers_owner_not_admin()

triggers.name: providers_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER providers_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.providers FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.cities
tables.comment: The markets lokl operates in, each named after its main city and covering its metro area (Atlanta covers Decatur, Marietta and so on). Admin-managed. Never deleted: providers and listings point here, so a market is deactivated instead.

columns.name: slug
columns.comment: URL-safe identifier, e.g. atlanta. Unique.

columns.name: state
columns.comment: Two-letter US state code, e.g. GA.

columns.name: timezone
columns.comment: IANA time zone name, e.g. America/New_York. Experience session times are entered and shown in it.

columns.name: active
columns.comment: Inactive cities are hidden everywhere public and in the provider city picker.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.comment: Display order in lists and pickers, lowest first.

indexes.name: cities_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cities_pkey ON public.cities USING btree (id)

indexes.name: cities_slug_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX cities_slug_key ON public.cities USING btree (slug)

triggers.name: cities_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER cities_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.cities FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.service_areas
tables.comment: Areas within a market: neighborhoods, cities or towns, and zip codes. Where "I come to you" Services travel, and the public location label on listings. Admin-managed. Never deleted: listings will point here, so an area is deactivated instead.

columns.name: city_id
columns.comment: The market this area belongs to.

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: neighborhood (e.g. Old Fourth Ward), city (a city or town within the market, e.g. Decatur) or zip (a five-digit zip code).

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Shown to customers, e.g. Old Fourth Ward, Decatur or 30312. Unique per market and kind.

columns.name: active
columns.comment: Inactive areas are hidden everywhere public.

indexes.name: service_areas_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX service_areas_pkey ON public.service_areas USING btree (id)

indexes.name: service_areas_city_id_kind_name_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX service_areas_city_id_kind_name_key ON public.service_areas USING btree (city_id, kind, name)

constraints.name: service_areas_city_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (city_id) REFERENCES cities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: service_areas_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER service_areas_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.service_areas FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.categories
tables.comment: Service and Experience categories. Flat and admin-managed; each listing belongs to one category of its own kind. Never deleted: listings will point here, so a category is deactivated instead.

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: service or experience. A listing can only use a category of its own kind.

columns.name: name
columns.comment: Shown to customers, e.g. Hair and beauty. 2 to 60 characters.

columns.name: slug
columns.comment: URL-safe identifier, unique within its kind, e.g. hair-and-beauty.

columns.name: description
columns.comment: Optional. Shown on the category page later. Up to 500 characters.

columns.name: active
columns.comment: Inactive categories are hidden everywhere public, and so are their listings.

columns.name: sort_order
columns.comment: Display order within its kind, lowest first.

indexes.name: categories_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_pkey ON public.categories USING btree (id)

indexes.name: categories_kind_slug_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_kind_slug_key ON public.categories USING btree (kind, slug)

indexes.name: categories_id_kind_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX categories_id_kind_key ON public.categories USING btree (id, kind)

triggers.name: categories_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER categories_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.categories FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.listings
tables.comment: A Service or Experience a provider offers. Deleted only while it has never been live (published_at is null); after that it is unlisted or unpublished, never deleted, because bookings will point at it.

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: service or experience. Fixed at creation.

columns.name: category_id
columns.comment: A category of the same kind, enforced by the (category_id, kind) reference.

columns.name: slug
columns.comment: Generated from the title with a short random suffix when the listing is created. Used by public listing pages; not changed afterwards.

columns.name: price_cents
columns.comment: Whole price in cents for a Service; per person for an Experience.

columns.name: duration_minutes
columns.comment: Required for Experiences; optional for Services.

columns.name: location_mode
columns.comment: Services only: provider_location (customer comes to the provider) or customer_location (provider travels, within listing_service_areas). Null for Experiences.

columns.name: area_id
columns.comment: The public location label, e.g. Old Fourth Ward. Required for provider-location Services and Experiences. Must be in the listing's city.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: draft, submitted, live, rejected or unpublished. Changed only by server routes.

columns.name: rejection_reason
columns.comment: Why an Experience was sent back. Set on rejection; cleared on resubmission.

columns.name: published_at
columns.comment: Set the first time the listing goes live and never cleared.

columns.name: unpublished_reason
columns.comment: Why the owner took the listing down, 10 to 1,000 characters; shown to the provider. Set when unpublished; cleared on restore. Server-only.

indexes.name: listings_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listings_pkey ON public.listings USING btree (id)

indexes.name: listings_slug_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listings_slug_key ON public.listings USING btree (slug)

indexes.name: listings_provider_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX listings_provider_id_idx ON public.listings USING btree (provider_id)

indexes.name: listings_live_city_category_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX listings_live_city_category_idx ON public.listings USING btree (city_id, category_id) WHERE (status = 'live'::text)

constraints.name: listings_area_required
constraints.def: CHECK ((((kind = 'service'::text) AND (location_mode = 'customer_location'::text)) OR (area_id IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: listings_experience_shape
constraints.def: CHECK (((kind <> 'experience'::text) OR ((duration_minutes IS NOT NULL) AND (location_mode IS NULL))))

constraints.name: listings_provider_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES providers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: listings_city_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (city_id) REFERENCES cities(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: listings_area_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (area_id) REFERENCES service_areas(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: listings_category_id_kind_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (category_id, kind) REFERENCES categories(id, kind) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: listings_check_references
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listings_check_references BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF category_id, city_id, area_id ON public.listings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION listings_check_references()

triggers.name: listings_guard_provider_edits
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listings_guard_provider_edits BEFORE UPDATE ON public.listings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION listings_guard_provider_edits()

triggers.name: listings_notify_status_change
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listings_notify_status_change AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.listings FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.status IS DISTINCT FROM new.status)) EXECUTE FUNCTION listings_notify_status_change()

triggers.name: listings_require_photo
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listings_require_photo BEFORE UPDATE OF status ON public.listings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION listings_require_photo()

triggers.name: listings_set_slug
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listings_set_slug BEFORE INSERT ON public.listings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION listings_set_slug()

triggers.name: listings_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listings_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.listings FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.listing_addresses
tables.comment: A listing's exact address. Private: readable only by the listing's provider and the admin (customers with a confirmed booking come later). Required for provider-location Services and Experiences before publishing or submitting. Deleted with its listing, or by the provider when it is no longer needed.

columns.name: instructions
columns.comment: Optional arrival notes, e.g. "Side entrance, ring twice".

indexes.name: listing_addresses_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listing_addresses_pkey ON public.listing_addresses USING btree (listing_id)

constraints.name: listing_addresses_listing_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES listings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.name: listing_addresses_guard
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listing_addresses_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.listing_addresses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION listing_addresses_guard()

triggers.name: listing_addresses_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listing_addresses_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.listing_addresses FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.listing_service_areas
tables.comment: Where an "I come to you" Service travels. At least one row is required before a customer-location Service can go live. Rows go with their listing; the provider removes a row to stop covering an area.

indexes.name: listing_service_areas_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listing_service_areas_pkey ON public.listing_service_areas USING btree (listing_id, service_area_id)

indexes.name: listing_service_areas_service_area_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX listing_service_areas_service_area_id_idx ON public.listing_service_areas USING btree (service_area_id)

constraints.name: listing_service_areas_service_area_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (service_area_id) REFERENCES service_areas(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: listing_service_areas_listing_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES listings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.name: listing_service_areas_check
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listing_service_areas_check BEFORE INSERT ON public.listing_service_areas FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION listing_service_areas_check()

triggers.name: listing_service_areas_guard
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listing_service_areas_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE ON public.listing_service_areas FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION listing_service_areas_guard()

tables.name: public.listing_photos
tables.comment: Photos of a listing, at most 8. Position 0 is the cover. At least one is required before a listing is published or submitted. Removed by the provider (not while submitted or unpublished, and never the last one of a live listing) or by the admin; rows go with their listing. Removing a row leaves the stored file.

columns.name: storage_path
columns.comment: Path in the listing-photos bucket: <provider_id>/<listing_id>/<random uuid>.<ext>. Must be in this listing's own folder.

columns.name: position
columns.comment: 0 to 7, unique per listing. 0 is the cover photo.

columns.name: alt_text
columns.comment: Describes the photo for screen reader users. Required, 5 to 200 characters.

columns.name: card_path
columns.comment: The card-sized copy (about 600px wide) of this photo, in the same folder: <uuid>.card.webp for <uuid>.<ext>, or <uuid>.card.jpg where the browser couldn't encode WebP. Null for photos added before card copies existed; pages then use the full photo. Set on upload, never changed.

indexes.name: listing_photos_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listing_photos_pkey ON public.listing_photos USING btree (id)

indexes.name: listing_photos_storage_path_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listing_photos_storage_path_key ON public.listing_photos USING btree (storage_path)

indexes.name: listing_photos_listing_id_position_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listing_photos_listing_id_position_key ON public.listing_photos USING btree (listing_id, "position")

indexes.name: listing_photos_card_path_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX listing_photos_card_path_key ON public.listing_photos USING btree (card_path)

constraints.name: listing_photos_listing_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES listings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.name: listing_photos_check
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listing_photos_check BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF storage_path, listing_id ON public.listing_photos FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION listing_photos_check()

triggers.name: listing_photos_guard
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listing_photos_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.listing_photos FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION listing_photos_guard()

triggers.name: listing_photos_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER listing_photos_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.listing_photos FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.experience_sessions
tables.comment: Dated sessions of an Experience, each with a number of spots. Providers add and change future sessions (not while the listing is submitted or unpublished); a session that has started is kept as it is. Deleted with their listing, or by the provider before they start; once bookings exist, a session with bookings is cancelled instead.

columns.name: starts_at
columns.comment: When the session starts. Entered and shown in the listing city's time zone (cities.timezone). Must be in the future and at most a year ahead when a provider adds or moves it.

columns.name: capacity
columns.comment: Spots in the session, 1 to 500. Spots left will be worked out from bookings.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: scheduled or cancelled. A cancelled session can't be changed or scheduled again.

indexes.name: experience_sessions_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX experience_sessions_pkey ON public.experience_sessions USING btree (id)

indexes.name: experience_sessions_listing_id_starts_at_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX experience_sessions_listing_id_starts_at_key ON public.experience_sessions USING btree (listing_id, starts_at) WHERE (status = 'scheduled'::text)

indexes.name: experience_sessions_starts_at_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX experience_sessions_starts_at_idx ON public.experience_sessions USING btree (starts_at)

constraints.name: experience_sessions_listing_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES listings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

triggers.name: experience_sessions_booked_guard
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER experience_sessions_booked_guard BEFORE UPDATE OF capacity, starts_at, status ON public.experience_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION experience_sessions_booked_guard()

triggers.name: experience_sessions_check
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER experience_sessions_check BEFORE INSERT OR UPDATE OF listing_id, starts_at, status ON public.experience_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION experience_sessions_check()

triggers.name: experience_sessions_guard
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER experience_sessions_guard BEFORE INSERT OR DELETE OR UPDATE ON public.experience_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION experience_sessions_guard()

triggers.name: experience_sessions_set_updated_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER experience_sessions_set_updated_at BEFORE UPDATE ON public.experience_sessions FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION set_updated_at()

tables.name: public.notifications
tables.comment: Things that happened to a provider's listings because of an admin action. Written only by the listings_notify_status_change trigger. Providers read their own and mark them read. Deleted with their listing; otherwise kept (a cleanup of old read ones comes later).

columns.name: provider_id
columns.comment: The recipient: the business that owns the listing.

columns.name: kind
columns.comment: listing_approved (submitted -> live), listing_rejected (submitted -> rejected), listing_unpublished (live -> unpublished) or listing_restored (unpublished -> live). The sentence shown is built from this and the listing's current title.

columns.name: read_at
columns.comment: When the provider marked it read; null while unread. Once set it doesn't change, and it can't be cleared.

columns.name: booking_id
columns.comment: For booking notifications: the booking it's about.

indexes.name: notifications_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX notifications_pkey ON public.notifications USING btree (id)

indexes.name: notifications_provider_id_created_at_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX notifications_provider_id_created_at_idx ON public.notifications USING btree (provider_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: notifications_unread_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX notifications_unread_idx ON public.notifications USING btree (provider_id) WHERE (read_at IS NULL)

indexes.name: notifications_listing_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX notifications_listing_id_idx ON public.notifications USING btree (listing_id)

constraints.name: notifications_provider_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES providers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: notifications_listing_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES listings(id) ON DELETE CASCADE

constraints.name: notifications_booking_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (booking_id) REFERENCES bookings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: notifications_set_read_at
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER notifications_set_read_at BEFORE UPDATE OF read_at ON public.notifications FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION notifications_set_read_at()

tables.name: public.commission_rates
tables.comment: lokl's commission per kind of listing, in basis points (1200 = 12%). Admin-editable. Each booking copies the rate in force when it's created, so changes never touch past bookings. Never deleted.

columns.name: rate_bps
columns.comment: Commission in basis points, 0 to 5000 (0% to 50%).

indexes.name: commission_rates_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX commission_rates_pkey ON public.commission_rates USING btree (kind)

constraints.name: commission_rates_updated_by_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (updated_by) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE SET NULL

triggers.name: commission_rates_stamp
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER commission_rates_stamp BEFORE UPDATE ON public.commission_rates FOR EACH ROW EXECUTE FUNCTION commission_rates_stamp()

tables.name: public.bookings
tables.comment: A customer's booking of a Service (a request the provider accepts) or an Experience session (paid at once). Written only by the website's server. lokl holds the payment and transfers the provider's share 24 hours after the booking ends. Never deleted: payments, refunds and payouts point here.

columns.name: status
columns.comment: pending_payment (in Stripe Checkout; spots held until reserved_until) -> requested (Service: card on hold, waiting for the provider) -> confirmed (accepted and charged, or Experience paid) -> completed (it happened) -> paid_out (provider's share transferred). Or declined, expired, cancelled. A customer's late cancellation (no refund) can still be paid out. The allowed changes are enforced by bookings_guard.

columns.name: preferred_times
columns.comment: Services: one to three times the customer offers, each at least 24 hours ahead when requested. The provider accepts one, which becomes starts_at.

columns.name: starts_at
columns.comment: Experiences: the session's start, copied. Services: the accepted preferred time.

columns.name: ends_at
columns.comment: starts_at plus the listing's duration (or starts_at if it has none). Set by the database.

columns.name: party_size
columns.comment: People booked: 1 for Services; 1 to 10 for Experiences, and no more than the spots left.

columns.name: customer_name
columns.comment: The customer's name from checkout. The provider sees it on the request.

columns.name: commission_rate_bps
columns.comment: The commission rate in force when the booking was made (commission_rates), kept so later changes never affect it.

columns.name: provider_amount_cents
columns.comment: What the provider receives: total minus commission. lokl pays Stripe's fee from its commission.

columns.name: payout_due_at
columns.comment: When the provider's share may be transferred: 24 hours after ends_at. Set by the database on confirmation.

columns.name: payout_failed_at
columns.comment: When the provider's Stripe account couldn't receive the transfer; the payout is held until it's fixed, and the admin sees it under "needs attention".

columns.name: problem_reported_at
columns.comment: Set when the customer reports the provider didn't show; holds the payout until the admin acts.

columns.name: status_changed_by
columns.comment: Who made the latest status change; copied into booking_events.

columns.name: customer_city
columns.comment: "I come to you" Services: the customer's city, copied from their address when the request is made, so the provider sees roughly where before accepting. Never changes.

columns.name: customer_postal_code
columns.comment: "I come to you" Services: the customer's zip code, copied like customer_city. The street address stays in booking_addresses until the provider accepts.

columns.name: payout_hold
columns.comment: Why this booking's payout is held for lokl to review: a reported no-show, an open dispute, a refund on record, a suspended provider, a provider account that can't receive transfers, or a refused transfer (details in payout_failure). Set by the pay-out job; cleared only by the admin.

columns.name: payout_held_at
columns.comment: When the payout was held.

columns.name: disputed_at
columns.comment: When the customer's bank opened a dispute (chargeback) on this booking's charge, from Stripe's webhook. Holds the payout while open.

columns.name: dispute_closed_at
columns.comment: When the dispute closed; dispute_outcome says how.

indexes.name: bookings_pkey
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bookings_pkey ON public.bookings USING btree (id)

indexes.name: bookings_stripe_checkout_session_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bookings_stripe_checkout_session_id_key ON public.bookings USING btree (stripe_checkout_session_id)

indexes.name: bookings_stripe_payment_intent_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bookings_stripe_payment_intent_id_key ON public.bookings USING btree (stripe_payment_intent_id)

indexes.name: bookings_stripe_transfer_id_key
indexes.def: CREATE UNIQUE INDEX bookings_stripe_transfer_id_key ON public.bookings USING btree (stripe_transfer_id)

indexes.name: bookings_customer_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX bookings_customer_id_idx ON public.bookings USING btree (customer_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: bookings_provider_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX bookings_provider_id_idx ON public.bookings USING btree (provider_id, created_at DESC)

indexes.name: bookings_session_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX bookings_session_id_idx ON public.bookings USING btree (session_id) WHERE (session_id IS NOT NULL)

indexes.name: bookings_listing_id_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX bookings_listing_id_idx ON public.bookings USING btree (listing_id)

indexes.name: bookings_due_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX bookings_due_idx ON public.bookings USING btree (status, payout_due_at) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['confirmed'::text, 'completed'::text, 'cancelled'::text]))

indexes.name: bookings_respond_by_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX bookings_respond_by_idx ON public.bookings USING btree (respond_by) WHERE (status = 'requested'::text)

indexes.name: bookings_reserved_until_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX bookings_reserved_until_idx ON public.bookings USING btree (reserved_until) WHERE (status = 'pending_payment'::text)

indexes.name: bookings_open_idx
indexes.def: CREATE INDEX bookings_open_idx ON public.bookings USING btree (status, respond_by, reserved_until) WHERE (status = ANY (ARRAY['pending_payment'::text, 'requested'::text]))

constraints.name: bookings_confirmed_has_time
constraints.def: CHECK (((confirmed_at IS NULL) OR ((starts_at IS NOT NULL) AND (payout_due_at IS NOT NULL))))

constraints.name: bookings_customer_area
constraints.def: CHECK ((((customer_city IS NULL) = (customer_postal_code IS NULL)) AND ((kind = 'service'::text) OR (customer_city IS NULL))))

constraints.name: bookings_dispute_order
constraints.def: CHECK (((dispute_closed_at IS NULL) OR (disputed_at IS NOT NULL)))

constraints.name: bookings_experience_shape
constraints.def: CHECK (((kind <> 'experience'::text) OR ((session_id IS NOT NULL) AND (preferred_times IS NULL))))

constraints.name: bookings_service_shape
constraints.def: CHECK (((kind <> 'service'::text) OR ((session_id IS NULL) AND (party_size = 1) AND ((cardinality(preferred_times) >= 1) AND (cardinality(preferred_times) <= 3)))))

constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (customer_id) REFERENCES auth.users(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (provider_id) REFERENCES providers(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: bookings_listing_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (listing_id) REFERENCES listings(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

constraints.name: bookings_session_id_fkey
constraints.def: FOREIGN KEY (session_id) REFERENCES experience_sessions(id) ON DELETE RESTRICT

triggers.name: bookings_notify_problem
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER bookings_notify_problem AFTER UPDATE OF problem_reported_at ON public.bookings FOR EACH ROW WHEN (((old.problem_reported_at IS NULL) AND (new.problem_reported_at IS NOT NULL))) EXECUTE FUNCTION bookings_notify_problem()

triggers.name: bookings_notify_provider
triggers.def: CREATE TRIGGER bookings_notify_provider AFTER UPDATE OF status ON public.bookings FOR EACH ROW WHEN ((old.status IS DISTINCT FROM new.status)) EXECUTE FUNCTION bookings_notify_provider()

triggers.name: bookings_set_updated_at
